

```{r include=TRUE}
TR_max <- 500000
AEP <- AEPTable[p == p_TARGET & Tn %in% Tn_TARGET & TR<=TR_max & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1"]
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(min(Tn_TARGET),max(Tn_TARGET),Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)
DATA <- AEP[ ,.(ID=paste0("Tn= ",Tn," s"),X=Sa,Y=AEP)][order(X)]|> unique()
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="Sa(Tn) [g]",
  group.legend="Tn [s]",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT

```
